steps.en: Submissions that fail the automatic checks are sent to an officer
steps.id: Submission yang gagal pengecekan otomatis dikirim ke officer

steps.en: The notice is suspended automatically with a dedicated code
steps.id: Notice di-suspend otomatis dengan kode khusus

steps.en: The suspension runs for a set number of days
steps.id: Suspension berjalan selama sejumlah hari yang ditentukan
steps.why_en: The day count comes from reference data that the repo cannot show, with a 30-day default.
steps.why_id: Jumlah hari berasal dari data referensi yang tidak terlihat di repo, dengan default 30 hari.

steps.en: The notice stays suspended for as long as the review is pending
steps.id: Notice tetap tersuspend selama review belum selesai
steps.why_en: If the first suspension fails, the patch job is switched off, so a pending notice can escalate until the next daily run.
steps.why_id: Kalau suspension pertama gagal, job penambalnya mati, jadi notice pending bisa naik stage sampai job harian berikutnya.

steps.en: The suspension is lifted once the officer decides
steps.why_en: The screens officers use do not lift the suspension; it only ends when its days run out.
steps.why_id: Layar yang dipakai officer tidak mencabut suspension; baru berakhir saat harinya habis.
